description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the MacGatewayChatTransport mapping functions within the OpenClaw project. It verifies the mapping from various event frames and snapshots to internal health, tick, chat, and sequence gap representations.

classes.name: MacGatewayChatTransportMappingTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple unit tests for mapping various events and snapshots within the OpenClaw project's Mac gateway chat transport layer.

methods.name: `snapshot maps to health`
methods.description: Tests mapping of a snapshot to a health event.

methods.name: `health event maps to health`
methods.description: Tests mapping of a health event frame to a health state.

methods.name: `tick event maps to tick`
methods.description: Tests mapping of a tick event frame.

methods.name: `chat event maps to chat`
methods.description: Tests mapping of a chat event frame to chat data.

methods.name: `unknown event maps to nil`
methods.description: Tests that an unknown event type results in a nil mapping.

methods.name: `seq gap maps to seq gap`
methods.description: Tests mapping of a sequence gap event.
